description_en: Queries media files in a media fingerprint library
name: ListFpShotFiles

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询。请求第一页时，NextPageToken为空；请求后续文件时需传入前一页查询结果中的NextPageToken值
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media fingerprint library whose files you want to query. You can obtain the library ID from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的DNA库ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170149.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: fp_db_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The media files to be returned must be stored after the specified start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

This parameter is available only in the China (Beijing), China (Hangzhou), and China (Shanghai) regions
parameters.help_zh:
入库时间范围开始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`。

此参数支持使用的地域为华北2（北京）、华东1（杭州）、华东2（上海），暂不支持亚太东南1（新加坡）地域使用
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The media files to be returned must be stored before the specified end time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

This parameter is available only in the China (Beijing), China (Hangzhou), and China (Shanghai) regions
parameters.help_zh:
入库时间范围结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`。
此参数支持使用的地域为华北2（北京）、华东1（杭州）、华东2（上海），暂不支持亚太东南1（新加坡）地域使用
parameters.name: end_time

NextPageToken.description_en: The returned value of NextPageToken is a pagination token, which can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
